crossRefs.note: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”
To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore…
To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On…
Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on…
After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
translations.bsb: Some time later Joseph was told, “Your father is ill.” So he set out with his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
translations.asv: And it came to pass after these things, that one said to Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
